verdict.rationale: A machine-readable API description is a fair question for an engine or framework, and the evidence even mentions a first-party Bevy Remote Protocol that could carry such a spec. Yet probes found every OpenAPI or Swagger path returning 404, and no equivalent spec is documented. Static, crawlable docs.rs HTML is human-oriented reference documentation, not a downloadable machine-readable spec, so it earns no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can download a machine-readable API spec (OpenAPI or equivalent)
